name: Iterative Alignment Strategy
definition: An iterative process to generate better-aligned training and testing data by using optical flow to warp ground truth images to match the geometry estimated by NeRF, addressing misalignment from camera pose errors and non-rigid motion.
summary: Iterative Alignment Strategy mitigates NeRF reconstruction artifacts by iteratively warping ground truth images with optical flow to create better-aligned training data, unlike direct alignment methods that optimize loss during training.
